provenance.source: PR #11768 Validate model sql file provided config, merged 2025-06-25
provenance.note: the PR adds the first config validation at parse time, but it validates every Model node's _config_call_dict without knowing whether the node is a python model; python models add config_keys_used, config_keys_defaults, meta_keys_used and meta_keys_defaults to that dict themselves, so every python model raised a custom-key-in-config deprecation for keys no user wrote (#12314) until the fix passed is_python_model and skipped them

bugs.note: validate_model_config sees a python model's own internal keys in _config_call_dict and validates them as user-written config, so a custom-key-in-config deprecation is raised for keys the user cannot write; the fix passes is_python_model and skips the four internal keys
